How the score works

Every role has weight.

Each member chooses one game in the official regional Discord poll. The Dlicom team verifies the ballot and adds the role multiplier to that game’s score.

Fair play

Voting rules

The official poll takes place in Discord. This page displays manually verified statistics and does not accept votes.

Eligible regions onlyOnly official members of the RU and Nigeria regions are counted.
One regionVote only in the regional poll where you are officially registered.
One gameEach participant may select exactly one game on one ballot.
No duplicatesDuplicate and cross-region ballots are removed during verification.
No paid votesThere are no paid ballots or score boosts.
Highest weighted score winsThe game with the most role-weighted points becomes the tournament game.
